quotes: > **Status Note (2026-11-19):** All 9 target pangenome binaries in `src/bin/` (`horizon_wga` including `--graph`, `horizon_merge`, `horizon_guide`, `horizon_eval`, `horizon_gfa`, `horizon_clean`, `horizon_resolve`, `horizon_lift`, `bench_chr1`) now have unit tests (`46` passing tests + `1` ignored: `37` in `src/lib.rs` and `1` in each of the `9` binaries; `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean). Only `horizon_gfa stats` supports single-pass `"-"` `stdin` streaming; two-pass tools (`horizon_clean`, `horizon_resolve`, `horizon_lift`) and `horizon_wga` require seekable file paths. Remaining engineering limits (e.g., `KARLIN_MDL_COEFF = 0.55` and `LASTZ12` fallback `HashMap`s) are documented below.

* **MDL Bit-Savings (`src/bocpd.rs`, `src/mdl/`):** We replace classical substitution matrices with BOCPD joint-pair bit-savings (`joint_pair_bits`, skipping `'N'` bases in `bocpd_gc_profile`), use normalized Pair-HMM transitions (`src/mdl/dp.rs`, `src/mdl/dag.rs`: `M` and `Ix`/`Iy` outgoing probabilities sum to `1.0`), and adaptively estimate `identity_prior` (clamped `[0.60, 0.72]`), `gap_open_bits`, and `gap_extend_bits` from LCB anchors via `estimate_hmm_params` (`src/mdl/mod.rs`), wired into `mdl_xdrop_extend_with_params` (in `horizon_wga --graph`, `estimate_dag_hmm_params` adapts `identity_prior` from `<=2000` bp of exact `MASK_W10` seed hits and leaves `gap_open_bits`/`gap_extend_bits` at defaults). Structural chaining thresholds (`KARLIN_MDL_COEFF = 0.55`, `max_gap_bp = 2400`, `hsp_threshold`, `min_block_bits`) remain fixed heuristics. `ContigIndex` (`src/seeding/mod.rs`) now uses a compact `FlatSeedIndex` (`12 bytes/entry` post-build sorted `Vec<u64>` + `Vec<u32>`, peaking transiently at `~28 bytes/entry` during `build`, with on-the-fly reverse-complement coordinates; `ContigIndex` still retains `seq_rc` and `MASK_LASTZ12`/`MASK_LASTZ11` fallbacks still use `HashMap`s). Together with bundled `488b020` `rev_offsets`/`bocpd`/`dp` edits, `20 Mbp chr6 q-arm` peak RSS fell from `5,863.3 MB` to `2,409.7 MB` and `chr6` 5 Mbp pericentromere RSS fell from `3,084.5 MB` to `1,048.2 MB`.

* **E-Graphs for Structural Variants (`src/egraph.rs`, `src/bin/horizon_resolve.rs`):** Congruence-closure rewriting uses `MdlCostModel` (`extract_min_mdl_cost`: catalog pointer bits $\log_2 K$, `seq`/`inv` `1.0` bit, `dup` copy header `2.5` bits + $H_2(d) + d \log_2 3$ residual bits) and runs both inside `horizon_wga --resolve-dups` (benchmarked on 5 Mbp MHC/HLA and 20 Mbp `chr6` q-arm) and standalone `horizon_resolve` over anchor-bounded snarl/bubble windows in GFA `P`/`W` lines (`horizon_resolve --collapse-dups` updates `W`-line end coordinates and preserves `P`/`W` tags, while `L`-link rewriting remains open). Real HPRC `GRCh38` vs `CHM13` `chr22` and `chr6` pericentromere 5 Mbp loci are benchmarked in `docs/BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md`.

* **Buffered GFA Streaming Parser (`src/gfa/mod.rs`, `src/bin/horizon_gfa.rs`):** `stream_gfa` provides a buffered line-streaming reader for `H`/`S`/`L`/`P`/`W` GFA v1.0/v1.1 records (ignoring `C`/`J`/`U`/`O` records, coercing non-numeric `W` coordinates to `0`, and supporting `.gfa`, multi-member BGZF `.gfa.gz` via `MultiGzDecoder`, and uncompressed `"-"` `stdin`, with unit tests for empty `L`-line orientations and `.gfa.gz`). It is **not** zero-copy (it allocates owned `String`/`Vec<u8>` fields per record), but on the 12 GB HPRC v1.0 Minigraph-Cactus graph (measured at `b857377`, not re-timed on `488b020`) `horizon_gfa stats` streamed `81.4M` segments (`3.29 Gbp`) and `113.0M` links in `88.84s` at **97.1 MB peak RSS**, and `horizon_gfa extract` extracted `GRCh38.chr22` + `CHM13.chr22` in `166.73s` at **456.1 MB peak RSS**. While modern indexed/disk-backed representations (`GBZ` / `GBZ-base` by Sirén et al., `gfaidx`) also address subgraph queries without full-graph RAM materialization, native streaming gives Horizon direct `H`/`S`/`L`/`P`/`W` interoperability without external `vg`/`odgi` dependencies.

quotes: Pairwise WGA results use the divergence-adaptive Pair-HMM (`HmmParams`: `identity_prior`, `gap_open_bits`, and `gap_extend_bits` estimated from LCB anchors with Beta prior shrinkage in `src/mdl/mod.rs`), BOCPD compositional profiles (`src/bocpd.rs`, ignoring non-ACGT `'N'` bases), and normalized Pair-HMM transitions (`src/mdl/dp.rs`, `src/mdl/dag.rs`), including `mdl_xdrop_extend_with_params` (in `horizon_wga --graph`, `estimate_dag_hmm_params` adapts `identity_prior` from `<=2000` bp of exact `MASK_W10` seed hits and leaves `gap_open_bits`/`gap_extend_bits` at defaults). Note that `KARLIN_MDL_COEFF = 0.55` remains a fixed constant, and MAF-extracted FASTAs sample homologous blocks (`horizon_eval` evaluates reference-MAF `(ref_id, tgt_id)` contig pairs individually rather than all-vs-all across scaffolds). Earlier WGA rows (`multiz100way`, `cactus447way`, `multiz470way`, `cactus241way chr22_random`, `GRCh38.chr22 vs CHM13.chr22`) are **stale** (recorded prior to `488b020` `FlatSeedIndex` / `rev_offsets` / `dp` edits), and `horizon_gfa stats`/`extract`/`horizon_lift`/`horizon_resolve` rows were recorded at `b857377` (not re-timed on `488b020`). `cactus241way chr22 1MB`, `chr22_peri_5m`, `chr6_peri_5m`, and `chr6_q20m` below were measured on `488b020` (bundling `FlatSeedIndex` with `rev_offsets`/`bocpd`/`dp` edits).
* UCSC cactus241way `chr22 1MB`: **62.3%** recall / **60.3%** precision (Dog, across 31 target contigs evaluated per-pair vs reference MAF; **61.3% F1** in **17.16s**).

* Full-graph streaming (`horizon_gfa stats`, counter-only pass at `b857377`): **88.84s**, **97.1 MB** peak RSS across `81,415,956` segments (`3.29 Gbp`), `112,955,105` links, `2,580` paths, and `24,456` walks.

* Real HPRC `chr22` Pericentromere 5 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr22:15.5M-20.5M` vs `CHM13.chr22:15.73M-20.73M`): **14.57s**, **1,861.9 MB** peak RSS, **5,106,541** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs (`1.164x` multiplicity; `unique_x_bp=4,387,655`, `unique_y_bp=4,549,858`; no external truth baseline), `16,083` Horizon Bubbles.

* `chr6` q-arm 20 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr6:65M-85M` vs `CHM13.chr6:61M-81M`): **47.51s**, **2,409.7 MB** peak RSS (`0.120 GB/Mbp`, down from `5,863.3 MB` / `0.293 GB/Mbp` via `488b020` bundling `FlatSeedIndex` [`12 bytes/entry` post-build, `~28 bytes/entry` build peak] + `rev_offsets`/`bocpd`/`dp` fixes), **15,025,501** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs (`unique_x_bp=14,999,823`, `unique_y_bp=14,998,488`, `75.0%` deduplicated coverage), `16,877` Horizon Bubbles. (Prior to `FlatSeedIndex`, full `GRCh38.chr6` `170.8 Mbp` vs `CHM13.chr6` `110.7 Mbp` hit `26.5 GB` RSS; a completed full-`chr6` run with `FlatSeedIndex` remains pending — `10.09 GB` was only an unfinished mid-run check.)
